# alphaTab (vendored)

`alphaTab.core.min.mjs` is the unmodified ES-module build of
[@coderline/alphatab](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@coderline/alphatab) **1.9.0**
([source](https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab)), licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`).

Promo Studio uses only its file importers (Guitar Pro 3–8, GPX, MusicXML) to read tabs. The scrolling
tab on the video is drawn by `js/tab.js`. The file is loaded lazily, the first time a tab is opened.
